issues.issue: Is the claimant's testimony credible enough to rely on?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says the interpreter misunderstood him about the songs; he disputes the credibility concerns.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says Tamil sources can be unreliable and evidence may be confected.
issues.result_quote: Given all of these concerns about his testimony, I find that the presumption of truthfulness is unsustainable.

issues.issue: Does the claimant have a genuine fear and a serious chance of detention and torture on return to Sri Lanka?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears detention and torture as a returning MV Sun Sea passenger with LTTE links.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says no reason exists to mistreat him; relatively few passengers found LTTE-linked.
issues.result_quote: On the evidence, I find that there is a serious chance that the claimant will be detained and tortured in Sri Lanka, for the reasons cited above.

issues.issue: Is there a Convention nexus, namely imputed political opinion?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant perceived as Tamil with a remote LTTE connection; imputed political opinion.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, I find that the claimant has a nexus to the Convention on the ground of his imputed political opinion

issues.issue: Are state protection and internal flight alternatives available?
issues.applicant_position: Source of feared torture is the state or its paramilitary allies, so no protection or IFA.
issues.result_quote: state protection and internal flight alternatives are not available to the claimant.

issues.issue: Whether other grounds of risk under s.97 must be analysed
issues.applicant_position: Claimant relies on the sur place risk from the MV Sun Sea voyage.
issues.result_quote: Given my positive protection finding on the sur place claim, there is no point in analysing any other basis of risk to the claimant in Sri Lanka.
